lines.text: Korah, Dathan, Abiram and On rebel against Moses and Aaron with 70 men of Israel.
Moses tells Korah and his followers to take censers with fire and incense before the LORD tomorrow.
The ground splits open and swallows Korah's men and their households alive into Sheol.
Fire from the LORD consumes the 250 men, and Eleazar has their bronze censers hammered to overlay the tabernacle.
Aaron runs into the assembly with incense and stands between the living and the dead, and the plague is halted.
